name: Squad
description: Large-scale tactical military FPS with 100-player battles. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); large download.
notes: Server configuration lives in SquadGame/ServerConfig/ (Server.cfg for name/passwords, Rcon.cfg for RCON on TCP 21114, Admins.cfg, map rotations). A server license from Offworld Industries is only needed for licensed-server features; unlicensed community servers work fine. Windows hosts: set the start command override to SquadGameServer.exe with the same arguments.
